report.explanation: Alert observations show only HTTP 200 responses with sub-350ms durations; traces show all spans successful (200/ok) and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No error, timeout, or saturation signal is present in current evidence, so no root-cause candidate is substantiated. Historical references are simulated and advisory only. Need dependency-level latency/error and pool metrics to distinguish downstream-latency, redis-timeout, or db-pool-exhaustion.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql, inventory->redis over the incident window
Trace spans with error status or long durations (none observed; all sampled spans returned 200)
Postgres connection pool saturation metrics (pool size/idle only show 1/1 in sampled spans)
Redis operation latency/timeout metrics for reserve_inventory
Baseline comparison of checkout p95 latency to confirm 437ms is anomalous
